text: dsh-skill-install 是面向 DSH Web 设置页的技能安装器，通过“技能”设置区提供 GitHub 仓库搜索或地址查询、SKILL.md 列表、按需安装与移除、已安装及已加载技能查看，并支持全局、工作区和自定义目录。自定义目录由插件注册技能提供方并监听刷新。可选配置 GitHub Token 和代理；查询及技能文件获取会访问 GitHub。

dsh-skill-install adds a Skills page to DSH Web settings. Search GitHub or enter a repository address, browse SKILL.md files, install selected skills globally, in a workspace, or in a custom directory, and view or remove installed skills. A GitHub token and proxy are optional.

dsh-skill-install 的功能「查找并选择技能」：在 Web 设置页按仓库名搜索或输入仓库地址，打开仓库后浏览其中的 SKILL.md 项并勾选要安装的技能。
dsh-skill-install 的功能「安装与管理技能」：将选中的技能安装到全局、工作区或自定义目录；页面还能查看本插件已安装及当前已加载技能，并提供移除入口。
可选 GitHub Token 保存在本地配置文件，并随 GitHub API 请求发送；技能文件从 GitHub 获取。

dsh-skill-install README · dsh-skill-install：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) skill installer. From the Web settings page
(Settings → "Skills"), search GitHub repositories by name or paste a repo URL, list the `SKILL.md` skills inside,
tick the ones you want, and install them to a target directory. Integrates with the built-in skill-filesystem, so
installed skills take effect immediately — no restart required.

[中文](README.zh.md)

dsh-skill-install README · Features：- **Search by name / paste a URL**: one input accepts a skill/repo name (searches repos by name), or `owner/repo`
  and `https://github.com/owner/repo` addresses.
- **Only matched repos**: search returns concrete matching repositories; click "Open" to browse their skills.
  There is no full-site discovery feed.
- **Selectable target, global by default**:

dsh-skill-install README · Features：Targets are **global** (`<DSH_HOME>/skills`), **a workspace** (`<workspace dir>/.dsh/skills`, read from the host registry), or **a custom absolute directory**. 
- **Installed list**: grouped by target directory, one-click removal.
- **Currently loaded skills**: the merged set from the built-in skill-filesystem and this plugin (read-only).
- **Proxy (collapsed entry)**: configure a proxy address, test connectivity, or clear it; requests go through the
  system `curl` when set, direct otherwise.
dsh-skill-install README · Local directory — quit the Desktop app first; --profile is required.：dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-skill-install

dsh-skill-install README · Runtime dependencies：- The host plugin is pure ESM with no external runtime dependencies (`js-yaml` is bundled in `js-yaml.mjs`, MIT).
- Extracting the GitHub tarball needs system `tar` (built into Windows 10 1809+); using a proxy needs `curl`.
